memories.action: tokio is declared with default-features = false: every module needs its feature listed in Cargo.toml (net for TcpListener, TcpStream, UdpSocket). An unresolved import gated behind a feature means add the feature.
memories.applicability: Tokio import errors saying an item is configured out or gated behind a feature in lantern.
